last_commit_summary: Added a user-adjustable roof pitch (replacing the fixed per-roof-type allowance factors, so item-list quantities and the 3D model's roof tilt derive from one real pitch angle) and an open-sided lean-to add-on off the back wall, with its own support posts, roof framing, roofing, and fasteners, both in the item list and the 3D model. Pulled in from reviewing a competitor shed configurator (Best Sheds Designer / ACT Building Systems).
